entities.summary: Milan I, a notable figure in the history of Serbia, associated with Serbian Revolution & Kingdom (1830–1903). Preceded by Independence & Kingdom of Serbia and Miloš Obrenović's Second Uprising secures autonomy. Their legacy influenced Balkan Wars & Road to World War I and Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo triggers WWI.
